text.div:
Generated Narrative: CodeSystem TrustDemoDataElements

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/trust-demo/CodeSystem/TrustDemoDataElements defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
TD.J1.DE01 NameThe child's name as the birth hospital records it.
TD.J1.DE02 Date of birthThe child's date of birth.
TD.J1.DE03 Parent or guardian nameThe parent or guardian, for a subject with no identity document such as a newborn (STT-PAY-005).
TD.J1.DE04 Hospital numberThe birth hospital's own identifier for the child. It is not carried in the DVC.
TD.J1.DE05 Vaccine productThe product given, in the issuer's product coding (illustrative PreQual-style codes).
TD.J1.DE06 Date of vaccinationThe date the dose was given. The hospital record holds the time as well; the DVC carries the date.
TD.J1.DE07 Batch numberThe batch (lot) of the vaccine given.
TD.J1.DE08 Dose numberThe dose's number in its series. Recorded by the hospital; the minimal DVC payload does not carry it.
TD.J1.DE09 Supervising clinicianThe clinician who gave or supervised the dose.
TD.J1.DE10 Issuing countryThe trust-network participant whose key signs the DVC (J1: XXR).
TD.J1.DE11 Issued atWhen the DVC was signed.
TD.J1.DE12 Expires atWhen the DVC stops verifying, where the issuer sets an expiry.
TD.J1.DE13 Key identifier (kid)Identifies the document signer certificate on the trust list that verifies the DVC (J1: 916ffa567c0f44a2).
TD.J2A.DE01 Household idThe household on the CHW's roster that the child joins.
TD.J2A.DE02 Child's given nameThe child's given name.
TD.J2A.DE03 Child's family nameThe child's family name.
TD.J2A.DE04 Date of birthThe child's date of birth.
TD.J2A.DE05 Country of birthThe country the child was born in, when abroad.
TD.J2A.DE06 Foreign vaccination cards heldWhether the family holds vaccination cards from abroad.
TD.J2A.DE07 Temporary idThe id the child carries until civil registration catches up.
TD.J2A.DE08 Registered byThe community health worker who registered the child.
TD.J2A.DE09 Registered atWhen the registration was captured, on the phone, possibly offline.
TD.J2A.DE10 InformantThe family member who gave the answers.
TD.J2A.DE11 Dose read from a foreign cardOne dose read from a foreign DVC with the unverified triage read (STT-VER-011), saved as reported by the family.
TD.J2A.DE12 Vaccine product (as read)The issuer's product code as read from the card; no national code is added yet.
TD.J2A.DE13 Date of vaccination (as read)The date of vaccination as read from the card.
TD.J2A.DE14 Batch number (as read)The batch number as read from the card.
TD.J2A.DE15 Reported byThe family member who showed the card: the dose's information source.
TD.J2A.DE16 Record outcomeAlways reported-unverified for a triage read (decision table TD.DT.01); recorded as primarySource false with a note.
TD.J2B.DE01 ChildThe child referred.
TD.J2B.DE02 Referred byThe community health worker who made the referral.
TD.J2B.DE03 Referred toThe clinic that will verify the cards.
TD.J2B.DE04 Referred atWhen the referral was made.
TD.J2B.DE05 ReasonWhy the child is referred: unverified foreign vaccination cards.
TD.J2B.DE06 Doses to verifyThe reported doses the clinic is asked to verify.
TD.J2B.DE07 Referral statusActive until the clinic records an outcome for every dose it lists, then completed (indicator TD.IND.03).
TD.J3A.DE01 Key identifier (kid)The kid of the DVC verified, which names the signer's certificate.
TD.J3A.DE02 Issuing countryThe participant that signed the DVC (CWT iss).
TD.J3A.DE03 Verified atWhen the verification ran.
TD.J3A.DE04 VerifierThe system that verified the DVC.
TD.J3A.DE05 Verification resultThe library's typed result (STT-VER-008).
TD.J3A.DE06 Failed stepThe step at which verification stopped, when it failed.
TD.J3A.DE07 Failure reasonWhy verification stopped, when it failed: the input of decision table TD.DT.01.
TD.J3A.DE08 Trust list refreshed atWhen the verifier last refreshed its cached copy of the trust list; a signer added since then fails with KidNotFound (STT-VER-006).
TD.J3A.DE09 Record outcomeWhat the DVC becomes in the record (decision table TD.DT.01).
TD.J3A.DE10 Imported doseThe dose recorded from the verified DVC.
TD.J3A.DE11 Reported dose replacedThe reported dose the verified one replaces.
TD.J3A.DE12 Trust policyThe trust framework the DVC was verified under.
TD.J3B.DE01 Issuer's product codeThe vaccine code as the issuer signed it; kept, never replaced (STD-SEM-001).
TD.J3B.DE02 National schedule codeThe national schedule's antigen-and-dose code, added beside the product code. Absent for an unmapped dose, which the TrustDemoLaoImmunization profile (laoEpi 1..1) does not yet represent.
TD.J3B.DE03 Mapping basisHow the schedule code was found (decision table TD.DT.02).
TD.J3B.DE04 Confirmed byThe clinician who confirmed an equivalent the map did not cover.
TD.J3B.DE05 Counts toward the scheduleWhether the schedule counts the dose (decision table TD.DT.03): only doses from a primary source with a national schedule code.
TD.J3B.DE06 Dose dueA dose of the national schedule the evaluation finds due (decision table TD.DT.04).
TD.J3B.DE07 Schedule doseThe schedule's antigen-and-dose code of the dose due.
TD.J3B.DE08 Forecast statusThe forecast for the dose.
TD.J3B.DE09 Due dateThe child's date of birth plus the schedule action's timing age.
TD.J3B.DE10 ReminderThe reminder created for the next visit.
TD.J40.DE01 SubjectThe family member whose summary is shared.
TD.J40.DE02 HolderThe person who shares the link and decides who may open it.
TD.J40.DE03 CustodianThe home-country service that hosts the record and checks every request.
TD.J40.DE04 Shared documentThe patient summary the link releases.
TD.J40.DE05 Valid fromThe first day the link may be opened.
TD.J40.DE06 Valid untilThe expiry the holder chose; after it the link releases nothing (STD-ACC-001).
TD.J40.DE07 PurposeThe purpose of use the holder allows (J4: treatment).
TD.J40.DE08 Passcode setWhether the holder protected the link with a passcode. The passcode itself is never stored in the record.
TD.J40.DE09 Withdrawn atWhen the holder withdrew the link, if they did.
TD.J41.DE01 Requested atWhen the request arrived.
TD.J41.DE02 RequesterThe receiving system abroad that asked for the manifest.
TD.J41.DE03 Requester network addressWhere the request came from.
TD.J41.DE04 CustodianThe home-country gateway that answered and logged the request.
TD.J41.DE05 PatientWhose record was asked for.
TD.J41.DE06 ReleasedWhether the manifest was released (decision table TD.DT.05).
TD.J41.DE07 Audit outcome0 when released; 4 (minor failure) when refused.
TD.J41.DE08 Refusal reasonWhy nothing was released, when refused.
TD.J41.DE09 ConsentThe holder's consent the request was checked against.
TD.J41.DE10 Document releasedThe summary released, when released.
